No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the notices. Further, despite repeated reminders from the Commission during hearings, none of the Respondents has filed a reply to the Petition. 7. Hearings in the matter were held on 22.4.2025 and 20.6.2025, and the order was reserved. 8.
